entries.03c6be50de36b146: This business manufactures and sells agrochemicals, and provides control of pests and weeds related to agrochemicals. The company sells the products it manufactures and goods it procures through affiliated companies, to agricultural cooperatives and prefectural economic federations through the National Federation of Agricultural Cooperative Associations (Zen-Noh), and also through trading companies and authorized dealers, among others. Consolidated subsidiaries Fuji Green Co., Ltd. and Sankei Green Co., Ltd. also sell agrochemicals and provide pest control services, and equity-method affiliate Ryukyu Sankei Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells agrochemicals and other chemical industrial products.
